lines.1: 「That's what we were talking about at the school gate this morning.」
lines.2: We kept talking while Otome massaged me.
lines.4: I'd only used Otome's name so Konoe wouldn't dig in her heels and refuse my help.
lines.5: If Otome explained it like that, it made it sound like I was into her.
lines.8: I lay face down on the bed.
lines.10: She straddled me and set both hands along the muscles of my back.
lines.13: 「No. You endure it with fighting spirit.」
lines.15: Wasn't this just training disguised as a massage?
lines.16: 「Don't tense up so much... There. Feels good, doesn't it?」
lines.18: A rapid series of tiny bursts of pressure.
lines.21: Looked like I'd sleep soundly again tonight.
lines.22: 「So, did something happen with the drama club over the holiday?」
lines.24: I told her the story while she massaged me.
lines.25: 「So in the end, it looks like everyone pulled together again.」
lines.27: The sports nut was moved by the whole youth-drama story.
lines.28: 「So basically, they ended up solving it themselves.」
lines.29: 「I'm not even sure whether I really helped Konoe at all.」
lines.30: 「You did well. Konoe appreciates it too.」
lines.31: 「All right. For all that hard work, your big sis has a stylish little present for you.」
lines.32: 「Kurogane-Style Bodywork Secret Art... Compassionate Wild Dance!」
lines.33: 「There, there, there, there, there, there, there, there!!!」
lines.35: A rapid-fire massage focused straight on my pressure points!
lines.36: It felt so good I couldn't help crying out.
lines.37: For some reason, memories from my whole life started flashing back too!
lines.40: As my consciousness gradually faded away, I became a bird.
lines.41: 「He passed out... but he looks happy.」
